items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I think Nat T'oles' band was closer to -- I would put it like the Jimmy Lunceford style.

ctx.x: Had a nice arrangement on that. "The First Time I Saw You." You know, I'll tell you though, I think Nat T'oles' band was closer to -- I would put it like the Jimmy Lunceford style.

items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: So then he come back for the third time and that was the band I was in.

ctx.x: Budd was in that band. And Eddie Durham,

Eddie Tompkins, who later played with Jimmie Lunceford, Jess_e Stone[?]-- oh, had a fantastic band. I heard them, you know, but they didn't last long. He came to Kansas City and they all went but Jess Stone. So then he come back for the third time and that was the band I was in. I was in the --
He never made it really. Holder.
